recipe: Original LightX2V Ref2VA Turbo, four steps
scope: One run per scene and mode, no retries or seed selection. Whole-mode examples with non-blind sampled-frame review. Timings include complete generation; brief release UI work and CPU video processing overlapped the serial queue. No component attribution or universal quality ranking.
reference_images: Not distributed. Ordered file hashes are included per case.
audio_scope: Media specifications and complete decode checked; comparison audio is decoded-PCM identical to each original. Subjective voice quality, dialogue accuracy and precise lip sync are not certified by this visual review.
review_method: Non-blind inspection of frames 0,4,...,116 (6 fps, 30 samples per original clip), in chronological contact sheets. Inspect additional full-resolution frames where stated. This is not continuous-motion blind review.

cases.title: The Dandelion Prank
cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is 99, the single pastel-pink rabbit whose front, side and back identity views appear in <Picture 1>. She has long upright ears with darker pink centers, rounded cheeks, black dot eyes, a tiny dark nose, a yellow pinafore with one pink square front pocket over a white short-sleeved shirt, and white shoes. The views show one character.
<Subject 2> is bobo, the single caramel-brown bear whose front, side and back identity views appear in <Picture 2>. He has round ears with cream centers, a cream oval muzzle, dark dot eyes and black nose, pink cheeks, a sage-green short-sleeved T-shirt with one yellow chest pocket, cream shorts, and white shoes. The views show one character.
<Subject 3> is the hand-painted 2D storybook rendering style of <Picture 3>: warm dark-brown outlines, rounded simple characters, softly painted foliage, rolling hills and gentle natural light. This picture supplies drawing style and scenery texture; the cast of the new story consists of 99 <Subject 1> and bobo <Subject 2>. Its interface badges and incidental characters are not scene elements.

summary:
[reference generation] In five seconds, 99 blows a dandelion puff toward bobo; one drifting seed tickles his nose, he sneezes once, and the two share a giggle. Preserve the identities of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> with the drawing style of <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the single rabbit's pink identity, long ears, yellow pinafore, pink pocket, white sleeves and shoes throughout the new action.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the single bear's brown identity, cream muzzle and ears, green shirt, yellow pocket, cream shorts and white shoes throughout the new action.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - transfer its soft painted 2D illustration and warm outlines into the newly described scene, with the stated time-of-day lighting. Character sheets supply identity rather than multi-view staging.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A clean full-screen hand-drawn 2D cartoon uses the painted style of <Subject 3>. A static medium two-shot shows 99 <Subject 1> on the left and bobo <Subject 2> on the right, from their knees up with both complete heads, ears and hands visible. They face each other at arm's length in a sunny meadow, with softly painted flowers and distant hills behind them. 99 holds the thin stem of one white dandelion puff in her right hand between their faces; bobo's paws rest near his sides. During the first second she raises it near her mouth and leans forward. From about 1.0 to 2.3 seconds she blows once: white feathery seeds detach and float rightward across the gap, while the same stem remains in her hand. Bobo watches the seeds; one brushes his nose and he wrinkles his muzzle. Around 2.8 seconds bobo, with a warm medium-low youthful masculine voice (S1), makes one small comic sneeze with a brief forward head bob and audible "achoo", then straightens. From 3.4 seconds 99 lowers the now sparse dandelion stem, closes her eyes briefly in a light medium-high feminine giggle (S2), and bobo (S1) smiles back with a quiet warm chuckle. Hold the two smiling at one another through the last half second. Their feet stay planted; the gentle seed motion and sneeze carry the action. Natural nonverbal reactions only, without a spoken sentence or written text.

overall_soundscape:
A faint meadow breeze and a few distant birds remain beneath one soft blowing breath, one clearly timed small sneeze, then the rabbit's light giggle and the bear's warm chuckle.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A

review.actions: Both show 99 blowing the dandelion, seeds crossing bobo's face, bobo's sneeze gesture and a smiling/laughing ending. Timing differs: VSA sneeze gesture around 3.33-4.17 s; SOL around 3.17-3.83 s.
review.composition: VSA uses a closer upper-body composition; SOL shows more of the bodies and shoes. The difference limits direct pixel comparisons.
review.visible_issues: No severe character duplication, identity collapse or unwanted visible text observed in the sampled frames. Seed wisps pass in front of bobo's face, as requested; this is not classified as duplicate character contours.
review.additional_inspection: Labelled comparison at 3.5 s checked for placement and preserved source framing.

summary:
[reference generation] In five seconds, 99 launches a small red paper boat into a clear stream while bobo gives it a gentle push, then both wave as it sails away. Preserve the identities of <Subject 1> and <Subject 2> with the drawing style of <Subject 3>.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the single rabbit's pink identity, long ears, yellow pinafore, pink pocket, white sleeves and shoes throughout the new action.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - retain the single bear's brown identity, cream muzzle and ears, green shirt, yellow pocket, cream shorts and white shoes throughout the new action.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A soft hand-painted 2D storybook scene in the style of <Subject 3>, with warm afternoon light on a shallow clear stream. A static medium-wide three-quarter side view frames the grassy near bank, both characters from their complete heads and ears to their shoes, and the water below their hands. 99 <Subject 1> crouches on the left and bobo <Subject 2> crouches on the right, side by side facing the stream. 99 holds one small folded red paper boat with both hands just above the surface; bobo's right paw hovers beside its rear edge. From 0.3 to 1.8 seconds 99 lowers the same red boat until its bottom touches the water, then opens her hands and lifts them clear, leaving it floating upright. From 1.8 to 2.5 seconds bobo touches the back of the boat lightly with one fingertip, pushes it once to the right, and retracts his paw completely. The current carries the red boat steadily toward the lower-right corner with a small V-shaped ripple. As the boat glides free, 99, with a bright medium-high youthful feminine Mandarin voice and a light warm timbre (S1), smiles and says <d>[Chinese] 出发啦！</d> around 2.7 to 3.5 seconds. Both then raise one free hand and give the departing boat a small wave, following it with their eyes. Finish with the boat visibly afloat farther to the right and the two still crouching happily together on the bank. The image remains a clean illustrated scene; the dialogue is spoken without subtitles.

overall_soundscape:
A quiet burbling stream, a soft water-contact sound as the boat is set down, faint grass rustle and the rabbit's single short Mandarin line. The bear does not speak.

non_diegetic_music:
A quiet playful acoustic plucked melody with two or three light notes, below the stream and speech.

review.actions: Both show lowering the boat, its later movement away from the characters, and waving. SOL shows the paw/boat contact more clearly. VSA's exact push contact is harder to establish because the boat is close to the bottom edge.
review.composition: VSA repeatedly clips part of the boat at the lower frame boundary; SOL leaves more water below it and shows the boat more completely.
review.visible_issues: SOL has local edge softness around bobo's lower face, paw and boat during contact, especially around 2.17-2.67 s. VSA also has minor transition softness, but the action/framing difference prevents a general motion-quality ranking. Both retain the two subjects and recognizable clothing; no unwanted visible text observed at the sampled times.
review.additional_inspection: SOL frame 52 (2.167 s) viewed at full resolution; labelled comparison at 3.5 s checked.

detailed_description:
[Shot 1] A hand-painted 2D storybook scene using the warm brown outlines and soft foliage textures of <Subject 3>, now under blue-purple twilight. A static medium two-shot frames bobo <Subject 2> on the left and 99 <Subject 1> on the right from the waist up, including both complete heads and the rabbit's ears, with generous empty space above their faces. A quiet meadow and dark leafy silhouettes sit behind them. Bobo gently cups both paws together at chest height between the pair, with a small yellow-green light visible through the gap. 99 leans slightly closer and watches his paws with a curious smile. From 0.5 to 2.0 seconds bobo slowly separates and opens his paws, palms upward, revealing one tiny glowing firefly. review.actions: Both show a dusk scene, bobo opening the cupped paws, a single glowing insect lifting away and rising, and the two characters following the action with a smiling ending. SOL opens the paws earlier. Precise gaze direction is not established by these stylized faces.
review.composition: VSA uses a closer view and a larger insect. SOL shows more of the bodies and a smaller insect with less prominent wings.
review.visible_issues: VSA's large luminous wings make the intended tiny firefly look more like a glowing butterfly; SOL also stylizes the insect with visible wings. Moving pools of warm light change facial shading. No severe character duplication, collapse or unwanted text observed in the sampled frames.
